paragraphs: Cardinal Health, Inc. is a global healthcare services and products company providing customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, physician offices, and patients in the home. We provide medical products and pharmaceuticals and cost-effective solutions that enhance the healthcare system and supply chain efficiency.
In the United States, our Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions segment:
▪through its Pharmaceutical Distribution businesses:

•distributes branded and generic pharmaceutical and over-the-counter healthcare and consumer products to retailers (including chain and independent drug stores and pharmacy departments of supermarkets and mass merchandisers), hospitals, and other healthcare providers;
▪maintains prime vendor relationships that streamline the purchasing process, resulting in greater efficiency and lower costs for our retail, hospital, and other healthcare provider customers;
▪provides services to pharmaceutical manufacturers, including distribution, inventory management, data reporting, new product launch support, and chargeback administration;

▪distributes specialty pharmaceutical products to hospitals and other healthcare providers and provides consulting, patient support, and other services for specialty pharmaceutical products to pharmaceutical manufacturers and healthcare providers;
▪provides pharmacy management services to hospitals and operates a limited number of pharmacies, including in community health centers; and
▪repackages generic pharmaceuticals and over-the-counter healthcare products.

▪distributes specialty pharmaceutical products to hospitals, specialty pharmacies, and other healthcare providers and provides consulting, patient support, and other services for specialty pharmaceutical products to pharmaceutical manufacturers and healthcare providers;
▪provides services to pharmaceutical manufacturers, including distribution, inventory management, data reporting, new product launch support, and chargeback administration;
▪provides support and management services to physician practices through our MSO platforms; and
▪provides data analytics and insight services to biopharmaceutical manufacturers and healthcare providers.
See Note 13 of the "Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements" for Pharma segment revenue, profit, and assets for fiscal 2026, 2025, and 2024.

products and raw materials available to us and are subject to fluctuations in costs, availability, and regulatory risk associated with these products and raw materials.

Our business is affected by events outside of our control including public health crises, extreme weather-related events and natural disasters, geopolitical, economic, and other catastrophic events.
Our results of operations or strategic objectives could be adversely impacted if we fail to manage and complete divestitures.

paragraphs: The risks described below could materially and adversely affect our results of operations, financial condition, liquidity, or cash flows. These are not the only risks we face. Our businesses also could be affected by risks we do not currently consider material to our operations or of which we are not presently aware.

As described in the "Business" section, products that we manufacture, source, distribute, or market must comply with U.S. federal, state, and foreign and regulatory requirements. Noncompliance or concerns over noncompliance, including noncompliance by suppliers, has in the past, and may in the future result in suspension of our licenses or ability to distribute, import, manufacture, or source products, recalls, safety alerts or seizures, or criminal or civil sanctions, which, in turn, could result in product liability claims and legal action, including government investigations and enforcement actions and class action lawsuits. If we fail to comply with regulatory requirements, or if allegations are made that we fail to comply, our results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected.

To lawfully operate our businesses, we are required to obtain and hold permits, product registrations, licenses and other regulatory approvals from, and to comply with operating and security standards of, numerous governmental bodies. Failure to maintain or renew necessary permits, product registrations, licenses, or approvals, or to comply with required standards, could have an adverse effect on our results of operations and financial condition.

We are required to comply with laws relating to healthcare fraud and abuse. The requirements of these laws are complex and subject to varying interpretations. From time to time, regulatory authorities, including the DOJ, FDA, DEA, and FTC, investigate our policies or practices, and may challenge them. For example, in November 2023, we received a Civil Investigative Demand ("CID") from the Department of Justice focused on potential violations of the Anti-Kickback Statute and False Claims Act in connection with a 2022 transaction in which we purchased a group purchasing organization and a minority ownership interest in a rheumatology managed services organization. We are cooperating with this investigation. We are also periodically subject to federal or state government investigations or qui tam actions (false claims cases initiated by private parties purporting to act on behalf of federal or state governments), which could result in civil or criminal sanctions, including the loss of licenses or the ability to participate in Medicare, Medicaid, and other federal and state healthcare programs or other remedial measures.

Some of our businesses are Medicare-certified suppliers or participate in other federal and state healthcare programs, such as state Medicaid programs and the federal 340B drug pricing program. We are also subject to extensive U.S. federal healthcare

fraud and abuse laws, including the federal Anti-Kickback Statute, the federal self-referral law commonly known as the Stark Law and the federal False Claims Act. In addition, some businesses manufacture pharmaceutical or medical products or repackage pharmaceuticals that are purchased or reimbursed through, or are otherwise governed by, federal or state healthcare programs. Failure to comply with applicable eligibility requirements, standards, and regulations could result in civil or criminal sanctions, including the loss of our ability to participate in Medicare, Medicaid, and other federal and state healthcare programs.

Fiscal 2024 items and discussions of year-over-year comparisons between fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2024 that are not included in this Form 10-K can be found in Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025 (the "Fiscal 2025 Form 10-K").

Cardinal Health, Inc., an Ohio corporation formed in 1979, is a global healthcare services and products company providing customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, physician offices, and patients in the home. We provide pharmaceuticals and medical products and cost-effective services and solutions that enhance the healthcare system and supply chain efficiency. We connect patients, providers, payers, pharmacists, and manufacturers for integrated care coordination.

We report our financial results in two reportable segments: Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions ("Pharma") segment and Global Medical Products and Distribution ("GMPD") segment. All remaining operating segments that are not significant enough to require separate reportable segment disclosures are included in Other, which is comprised of Nuclear and Precision Health Solutions, at-Home Solutions, and OptiFreight® Logistics.

Our Pharma segment distributes branded and generic pharmaceutical, specialty pharmaceutical, and over-the-counter healthcare and consumer products in the United States. This segment also provides services to pharmaceutical manufacturers and healthcare providers for specialty pharmaceutical products; provides pharmacy management services to hospitals and operates a limited number of pharmacies, including pharmacies in community health centers; repackages generic pharmaceuticals and over-the-counter healthcare products; and includes our managed services organization ("MSO") platforms for physician offices.

Our GMPD segment manufactures, sources, and distributes Cardinal Health brand medical, surgical, and laboratory products, which are sold in the United States, Canada, Europe, Asia, and other markets. This segment also distributes a broad range of medical, surgical, and laboratory products known as national brand products to hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and other healthcare providers in the United States and Canada.

Our Nuclear and Precision Health Solutions operating segment operates nuclear pharmacies and manufacturing facilities, which manufacture, prepare, and deliver radiopharmaceuticals for use in nuclear imaging, theranostics, and other procedures in hospitals and physician offices. This segment also contract manufactures a radiopharmaceutical treatment (Xofigo®) and holds the rights to manufacture and distribute Lymphoseek®, a radiopharmaceutical diagnostic imaging agent.

Our at-Home Solutions operating segment has two main businesses: Edgepark, including Advanced Diabetes Supply Group ("ADS"), directly providing medical supplies to patients with chronic conditions in the home; and at-Home, a business-to-business distribution service that delivers medical supplies and over-the-counter products to home medical equipment providers, home health and hospice agencies, and e-commerce providers.

Our OptiFreight® Logistics operating segment supports the shipping and logistics needs of healthcare providers by optimizing direct shipments through integrated technology solutions. This operating segment serves hospitals, pharmacies, labs, and surgery centers.
Revenue for fiscal 2026 increased 14 percent to $254.2 billion from the prior year, primarily due to branded and specialty pharmaceutical sales growth from existing and new customers.

GAAP operating earnings for fiscal 2026 increased 15% to $2.6 billion from the prior year. The increase in GAAP operating earnings was driven by the increased contribution from branded and specialty pharmaceuticals and the performance of our generics program in our Pharma segment, the impact of the acquisitions of MSO platforms and ADS, and growth from existing customers in our GMPD segment. This increase was partially offset by the $184 million pre-tax goodwill impairment charge recognized in fiscal 2026 related to the Navista & Integrated Oncology Network ("ION") reporting unit within our Pharma segment, higher cash and share-based compensation costs resulting from the timing of acquisitions within The Specialty Alliance, and $171 million of net recoveries in class action antitrust litigation recognized in fiscal 2025. See "Critical Accounting Policies and Sensitive Accounting Estimates" section of this MD&A and Note 4 of the "Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements" for further information on the goodwill impairment.

Non-GAAP operating earnings for fiscal 2026 increased 30% to $3.6 billion from the prior year, primarily driven by the increased contribution from branded and specialty pharmaceuticals and the performance of our generics program in our Pharma segment and the impact of the acquisitions of MSO platforms and ADS.

若本公司未能妥善管理及完成資產處分，可能對營運結果或戰略目標造成不利影響。

paragraphs: 下列風險可能會重大且不利地影響我們的營運成果、財務狀況、流動性或現金流。這些並非我們唯一面臨的風險。我們的業務也可能受到我們目前認為對營運不具重大影響或尚未知悉的風險影響。

如「業務」部分所述，我們製造、來源、分銷或行銷的產品必須符合美國聯邦、州及外國的法規要求。不遵守法規或對不遵守法規的疑慮，包括供應商不遵守法規的情形，在過去曾導致我們的許可證或分銷、進口、製造或來源產品的資格被暫停，並可能導致產品回收、安全警示或扣押，或遭處刑事或民事處罰，進而可能導致產品責任訴訟及法律行動，包括政府調查與執法行動及羣體訴訟。若我們未能遵守法規要求，或有聲稱我們未能遵守法規，則我們的營運成果與財務狀況可能受到不利影響。
為合法運作我們的業務，我們必須自各政府機構取得並持有許可證、產品登記、許可證及其他法規核准，並遵守其營運與安全標準。未能維持或更新必要的許可證、產品登記、許可證或核准，或未能遵守相關標準，可能會對我們的營運成果與財務狀況造成不利影響。

我們必須遵守與醫療保健詐欺與濫用相關的法律。這些法律的規定複雜且解釋方式不一。時而，包括國防部（DOJ）、食品藥物管理局（FDA）、毒品管理局（DEA）及聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）等法規機關會調查我們的政策或作法，並可能對其提出質疑。例如，在2023年11月，我們收到了來自國防部的民事調查命令（"CID"），針對2022年我們購入一個團體採購組織及取得一家風濕病管理服務組織少數股權的交易，可能違反反賄賂法及虛假陳述法。我們正在配合此調查。我們也定期受到聯邦或州政府的調查或由私人當事人提出的偽裝詐欺案件（false claims cases），這些案件聲稱代表聯邦或州政府行事，這可能會導致民事或刑事處罰，包括喪失參與醫療保險、醫療救助及其他聯邦與州醫療保健計畫的資格，或其它補救措施。
我們的一些業務是醫療保險認證供應商，或參與其他聯邦與州醫療保健計畫，例如州醫療救助計畫及聯邦340B藥物價格計畫。我們也受到美國聯邦醫療保健
詐欺與濫用法律的廣泛規範，包括聯邦反賄賂法、聯邦自願轉介法（常見為史塔克法）及聯邦虛假陳述法。此外，一些業務製造藥物或醫療產品，或重新包裝透過聯邦或州醫療保健計畫購入或補償的藥物。未能遵守適用的資格要求、標準及法規，可能會導致民事或刑事處罰，包括喪失參與醫療保險、醫療救助及其他聯邦與州醫療保健計畫的資格。

paragraphs: Cardinal Health, Inc. 為一家全球醫療服務與產品公司，提供為醫院、醫療系統、藥房、門診手術中心、臨牀實驗室、醫生診所及居家病患量身打造的客製化解決方案。我們提供醫療產品與藥物，以及具成本效益的解決方案，以提升醫療系統與供應鏈效率。
於美國，我們的藥物與專利解決方案分部：
▪透過其藥物配送業務：
•將品牌藥物與通用藥物，以及過濾門診與消費者保健產品配送至零售商（包括連鎖與獨立藥房，以及超市與大型零售通路的藥房部門），醫院及其他醫療提供者；
▪維持主要供應商關係，以簡化採購流程，使我們的零售、醫院及其他醫療提供者客戶獲得更高的效率與更低的成本；
▪為藥物製造商提供服務，包括配送、存貨管理、數據報告、新產品發佈支援及回扣管理；
▪將專利藥物產品配送至醫院及其他醫療提供者，並為藥物製造商與醫療提供者提供專利藥物產品的諮詢、病患支援及其他服務；
▪為醫院提供藥房管理服務，並經營少量藥房，包括社區醫療中心；
▪重新包裝一般用藥品及非處方醫療產品。
▪將專利藥品分銷至醫院、專門藥房及其他醫療機構，並為藥品製造商及醫療機構提供專利藥品的諮詢、病患支援及其他相關服務；
▪為藥品製造商提供相關服務，包括分銷、存貨管理、數據報告、新產品發佈支援及回扣管理；
▪透過我們的 MSO 平台為醫療機構提供支援與管理服務；且
▪為生物製藥製造商及醫療機構提供數據分析與洞察服務。

paragraphs: 我們在本 Form 10-K 中的 MD&A 一般討論財務年度 2026 年及財務年度 2025 年的項目，以及財務年度 2026 年與財務年度 2025 年的年對年比較。財務年度 2024 年的項目及財務年度 2025 年與財務年度 2024 年的年對年比較討論，未包含在本 Form 10-K 中的，可於我們財務年度終止於 2025 年 6 月 30 日的年度報告 Form 10-K 中的 Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations 找到（稱為 "財務年度 2025 Form 10-K"）。

本報告（包括所引用的資訊）包含前瞻性陳述，討論預期、前景、估計及其他事項，這些事項依賴未來的事件或發展。許多前瞻性陳述出現在 MD&A 和風險因素中，但報告中其他地方也存在其他前瞻性陳述，這些陳述可能以 "expect"、"anticipate"、"intend"、"plan"、"believe"、"will"、"should"、"could"、"would"、"project"、"continue"、"likely" 及類似表達方式識別，並包含反映未來結果或指引的陳述、展望陳述及費用提列。這些事項受到風險與不確定性影響，可能導致實際結果與預期、預測或暗示的結果有重大差異。這些風險與不確定性中最重要的部分，已在本報告的 "風險因素" 部分及本報告所附的 Form 10-K 的 Exhibit 99.1 中說明。本報告中的前瞻性陳述僅以本文件的日期為準。除非法律另有規定，我們不承擔更新或修訂任何前瞻性陳述的義務。

我們的年度報告 Form 10-K、季度報告 Form 10-Q、現況報告 Form 8-K 及其修正案，可在我們的網站（www.cardinalhealth.com）上免費取得，位於 "投資人關係 — 財務資料 — SEC 檔案" 項目下，我們在電子檔提交給 SEC 或提供給 SEC 後，盡速提供。網站上或可存取的資訊並非本年度報告 Form 10-K 的一部分，也未經引用納入本年度報告 Form 10-K。SEC 也維護一個網站（www.sec.gov），您可以在該網站上搜尋年度、季度及現況報告、代理與資訊說明書及其他有關我們與其他公開公司的資訊。
Cardinal Health, Inc. 為一間成立於 1979 年的俄亥俄州公司，為一間全球醫療服務與產品公司，為醫院、醫療系統、藥房、門診手術中心、臨牀實驗室、醫生辦公室及居家患者提供客製化解決方案。我們提供藥品與醫療產品，以及具成本效益的服務與解決方案，以提升醫療體系與供應鏈效率。我們連結患者、醫療提供者、保險機構、藥師與製造商，以實現整合式照護協調。
我們將財務結果分為兩個應報告分部：藥品與專業解決方案（"Pharma"）分部與全球醫療產品與配送（"GMPD"）分部。所有不具足夠重要性而需獨立應報告分部披露的其他營運分部，均歸納於 Other 中，包含核能與精準健康解決方案、居家解決方案及 OptiFreight® 物流。
我們的 Pharma 分部於美國分銷品牌藥品與通用藥品、專利藥品及過濾藥品與消費者產品。此分部也為藥品製造商與醫療提供者提供專利藥品服務；為醫院提供藥房管理服務，並經營有限數量的藥房，包括社區衛生中心的藥房；重新包裝通用藥品與過濾藥品與消費者產品；並包含我們為醫生辦公室提供的管理服務組織（"MSO"）平台。
我們的 GMPD 分部製造、採購並分銷 Cardinal Health 品牌的醫療、手術與實驗室產品，這些產品在美國、加拿大、歐洲、亞洲及其他市場銷售。此分部也分銷廣泛的醫療、手術與實驗室產品，稱為國家品牌產品，供美國與加拿大醫院、門診手術中心、臨牀實驗室及其他醫療提供者使用。
我們的核能與精準健康解決方案營運分部經營核能藥房與製造設施，這些設施製造、準備並配送放射性藥品，用於核能影像、診斷與治療及其他醫院與醫生辦公室的程序。此分部也委外製造一種放射性藥品治療（Xofigo®），並擁有製造與分銷 Lymphoseek® 的權利，Lymphoseek® 是一種放射性藥品診斷影像劑。
本公司之 at-Home Solutions 應報告分部包含兩大主要業務：Edgepark，包括 Advanced Diabetes Supply Group（"ADS"），直接向居家患有慢性病患提供醫療用品；以及 at-Home，為企業對企業（B2B）的配送服務，將醫療用品及非處方藥品配送至居家醫療設備供應商、居家護理及安寧療護機構，以及電商供應商。
本公司之 OptiFreight® Logistics 應報告分部透過整合的科技解決方案，協助醫療機構優化直接配送，以滿足其運輸與物流需求。此應報告分部服務醫院、藥房、實驗室及手術中心。

財務年度 2026 年 GAAP 操作獲利成長 15%，達 26 億美元，較前一年成長。GAAP 操作獲利的成長主要來自標籤藥品與專利藥品的貢獻增加，以及本公司 Pharma 分部之通用藥品計畫表現，加上 MSO 平台及 ADS 的收購影響，以及本公司 GMPD 分部現有客戶的成長。此成長部分抵銷了財務年度 2026 年因 Navista & Integrated Oncology Network（"ION"）報表分部（屬於本公司 Pharma 分部）所認列的 1.84 億美元預提商譽減損費用，以及因 The Specialty Alliance 收購時點所導致的現金及認股權費用增加，以及財務年度 2025 年認列的 1.71 億美元類別行動反壟斷訴訟淨回收金。有關商譽減損之進一步資訊，請參閱本 MD&A 之 "關鍵會計政策與敏感會計估計" 章節，以及 "合併財務報表附註" 中的附註 4。
財務年度 2026 年非 GAAP 操作獲利成長 30%，達 36 億美元，較前一年成長，主要因標籤藥品與專利藥品的貢獻增加，以及本公司 Pharma 分部之通用藥品計畫表現，加上 MSO 平台及 ADS 的收購影響。
